import asyncio
from fastmcp import FastMCP, Context

server = FastMCP("Progress Logger")


@server.tool
async def process_items(items: list[str], ctx: Context) -> dict:
    """Process a list of items and log progress."""
    results = []
    total = len(items)
    
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        await ctx.log(f"Processing item {i}/{total}: {item}", level="info")
        
        # Simulate processing
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        results.append(f"Processed: {item}")
        
        # Log progress at intervals
        if i % max(1, total // 4) == 0:
            await ctx.log(f"Progress: {i}/{total} items completed", level="info")
    
    await ctx.log(f"Completed processing all {total} items", level="info")
    
    return {
        "total_items": total,
        "processed_items": len(results),
        "results": results
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(server.run_stdio_async())
